title: LoopPrune: Recurrent Pruning for Looped Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped diffusion Transformers reuse shared blocks to deepen computation and match larger models with fewer parameters, reducing storage and deployment burdens. Yet repeated attention and MLP computations remain costly. Pruning reduces storage and computation by removing redundant parameters or units. Training-free methods struggle to resolve recurrent contributions, while training-based methods lack explicit constraints on position-specific errors affecting later inputs and final outputs. We propose LoopPrune, a pruning and recovery framework addressing these requirements. Recurrent importance estimation combines shared-removal effects and position variation to select a shared structure; shared reconstruction pools recurrent input statistics to compensate weights. translated_title: LoopPrune：面向循环扩散Transformer的循环剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 循环扩散Transformer通过复用共享模块来深化计算，以更少的参数达到大模型的效果，从而降低存储与部署负担。然而，重复的注意力与MLP计算仍然代价高昂。剪枝通过移除冗余参数或单元来减少存储和计算开销。免训练方法难以解析循环贡献，而基于训练的方法缺乏对影响后续输入与最终输出的特定位置误差的显式约束。我们提出LoopPrune，一个满足上述需求的剪枝与恢复框架。循环重要性估计结合共享移除效应与位置变化来选择共享结构；共享重建汇集循环输入统计量以补偿权重。循环位置恢复在相同的学生状态下比较完整的去噪预测并匹配文本引导，在固定的稠密教师模型监督下更新所有学生参数。
tldr: LoopPrune提出了一种针对循环扩散Transformer的剪枝与恢复框架，通过循环重要性估计、共享重建和循环位置恢复三大机制，在降低存储与计算成本的同时有效保持模型性能。
en_tdlr: LoopPrune is a pruning and recovery framework for looped diffusion Transformers that combines recurrent importance estimation, shared reconstruction, and loop-position recovery to reduce storage and computation costs while preserving model performance.
